details: Over 50,000 undocumented migrants have entered Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta from Morocco within the last 24-48 hours, resulting in over 50 fatalities from drownings or being crushed. The Spanish army has been deployed, and Italy has suspended Schengen border-free travel with Spain, implementing stricter border checks. Thousands of migrants are reportedly returning to Morocco.
title: Mass Migrant Influx into Spanish Enclave of Ceuta

details: On August 1st, Russia conducted a substantial ballistic missile and drone attack on Kyiv, killing at least nine people and injuring many others. The assault damaged residential buildings, a school, and the Lithuanian embassy. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has urgently appealed for more Patriot interceptor systems, citing critically low stockpiles.
title: Russia Launches Massive Missile Attack on Kyiv, Ukraine Appeals for Aid

details: An oil tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, off the coast of Oman, on August 1st. The vessel's engine room sustained damage, though no casualties or environmental damage have been reported. This incident further exacerbates tensions between the United States and Iran regarding navigation in the crucial waterway for global oil and gas transport.
title: Oil Tanker Attacked by Unknown Projectile in Strait of Hormuz
